issue.title: [Bug]: edit_file 后 read-evidence 无法清除，bash 被永久阻塞，且报错路径指向已删除的文件

steps: In this single turn, use write_file to create calc_metrics.py containing value = 1 and print(value) on separate lines. Read it, then use edit_file to change value = 1 to value = 2. Read the updated file in full using read_file, then use bash to execute python3 calc_metrics.py. Show the actual command result.
expected: A successful fresh read satisfies the evidence requirement and the edited script can run.
defect: bash remains blocked by an outstanding read-evidence requirement despite a successful full read of the updated source.
Root cause: Persistent read-evidence debt is not reconciled with the observed edited file version. The exact-file read path and the global bash outstanding check can therefore disagree. #10223 replaces the debt gate with live file observations at mutation boundaries.

_meta.notes: Minimal self-contained version of the issue calc_metrics.py workflow. All operations must stay inside one user turn. An initial legitimate stale-read refusal alone is not the defect; require failed recovery after the fresh full read.
_meta.version_installation_validation: not_executed; historical launch and dependency compatibility must be checked before running
